name: qjs_is_function

ownership.argument: Class ids 13 and 41 are the same as on .155, which is what makes the alignment safe rather than a guess.

provenance.source: Body is identical to .155 0xc3bf280: reject every tag except -1, return 1 for class id 13, return the byte at obj+32+16 for class id 41, otherwise look the class up in the context's class table at *(*(ctx+16)+68)+24*class+16 and return whether a finalizer slot exists. Size 78 versus 52 on .155.

notes: Class ids 13 and 41 are the same as on .155, which is what makes the alignment safe rather than a guess.
